name: Cocoa
summary: Cocoa is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Cocoa beans and bean powder contain psychoactive compounds that when ingested or insufflated act as mild to moderate stimulants.

uses.text: Businesses as well as companies and their subsidiaries sell cocoa powder for baking because cocoa powder is used to add chocolate flavor to baked items or doughs.

sideEffects.en: Large amounts can cause restlessness, trouble sleeping, a faster heartbeat, headache and an upset stomach.
sideEffects.zh: 大量攝取可能造成坐立不安、難以入睡、心跳加快、頭痛與腸胃不適。
sideEffects.zhHans: 大量摄取可能造成坐立不安、难以入睡、心跳加快、头痛与肠胃不适。

fact.en: The cacao tree's Latin name, Theobroma, means food of the gods, and its main stimulant, theobromine, takes its name from it, not from bromine, which it does not contain. Dogs break theobromine down very slowly, which is why chocolate can poison them.
fact.zh: 可可樹的學名 Theobroma 意思是「眾神的食物」，其主要興奮成分可可鹼（theobromine）就是以此命名，而不是因為含有溴，它其實不含溴。狗分解可可鹼的速度非常慢，所以巧克力可能讓狗中毒。
fact.zhHans: 可可树的学名 Theobroma 意思是「众神的食物」，其主要兴奋成分可可碱（theobromine）就是以此命名，而不是因为含有溴，它其实不含溴。狗分解可可碱的速度非常慢，所以巧克力可能让狗中毒。
